collectionNotes: 已实现ESP32-C61的42个真实物理矩阵开关及客体GPIO扫描回读；字符映射/去抖由客体负责。键码UART、I2C从机、HID/BLE/ESP-NOW应用与原厂固件兼容未验证；未实机验证。
尺寸和照片估算明确区分。UNKNOWN 保留未知内部面；模型不能证明固件、总线或无线协议已运行。
官网已抓规格为84.7×54.3×6.15mm，尺寸图区分84×54×1mm PCB及78×48mm孔距；搜索缓存中的1mm不当作整机厚度。
42键使用厂商4×11矩阵及真实GPIO/扫描编号；(0,10)/(3,10)未装键。按键高度和金属外观估算，I2C从机/键码UART/BLE HID/ESP-NOW应用未验证，GPIO矩阵扫描已有实际客体回读，不将点击或ASCII回执当客体消费。
Runtime digital subset and actual guest/negative checks: docs/platform/m5-edge-runtime-20261126.md. These checks do not establish factory firmware compatibility or hardware validation.

The vendor bsp_keyboard.c comment incorrectly names ROW1/COM10 as absent; the manufacturer keymap and own photograph establish ROW0/COM10 and ROW3/COM10 as the two absent switches. All 42 populated positions are separately guest-scanned.

Actual batch020 compiled production Worker/WASM checks passed this SKU and its configured negatives; exact guest observations and hashes: docs/platform/evidence/m5-edge-runtime-20261126/worker-020.json. This validates the declared digital subset, not factory firmware or physical hardware.
